title: Commanders stun Bengals on walk-off field goal as Jayden Daniels leads improbable drive

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders stun Bengals on walk-off field goal as Jayden Daniels leads improbable drive
sources.description: Jayden Daniels connected with rookie Antonio Williams on two long pass plays, moving the Commanders 64 yards in 34 seconds to set up Drew Stevens’ 26-yard field goal as time expired.
